20260528_0001_key: On a pencil, what do the letters H and B in "HB" stand for?
20260528_0001_answer: In pencil grading, H stands for hard and B stands for black. HB sits near the middle, which is why it is so common for everyday writing.
20260528_0002_key: Why was 1900 not a leap year in the Gregorian calendar, while 2000 was?
20260528_0002_answer: Century years are not leap years unless they are divisible by 400. That made 1900 a common year and 2000 a leap year.
20260528_0002_opt3: Because century years divisible by 400 are leap years
20260528_0002_opt4: Because odd-numbered centuries cannot be leap years
20260528_0003_key: What is the main purpose of the tiny hole near the bottom of an airplane window?
20260528_0003_answer: The breather hole helps equalize pressure between window panes and reduces fogging. The passenger window is made of multiple layers, not one single sheet.
20260528_0003_opt1: It equalizes pressure between the panes
20260528_0003_opt3: It makes sound to keep birds away
20260528_0003_opt4: It lets Wi-Fi signals pass through
20260528_0004_key: The north shown by a compass needle is closest to which kind of north?
20260528_0004_answer: A compass responds to Earth's magnetic field, so it points toward magnetic north, not exactly the geographic North Pole. The difference is called magnetic declination.
20260528_0005_key: In the SI system, what is the base unit for luminous intensity?
20260528_0005_answer: The SI base unit for luminous intensity is the candela. Its name is related to candle, which makes it easier to remember.
20260528_0006_key: Why can the metal gallium melt in the palm of your hand?
20260528_0006_answer: Gallium melts at about 29.8 C, which is below body temperature. Heat from your hand can therefore turn solid gallium into liquid.
20260528_0006_opt1: Its melting point is below body temperature
20260528_0006_opt2: It is strongly attracted to magnets
20260528_0006_opt3: It burns when it touches air
20260528_0006_opt4: It is much lighter than water
20260528_0007_key: Why does dry ice not leave a puddle when it disappears?
20260528_0007_answer: Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide, and it sublimates directly from solid to gas. It seems to vanish because it becomes invisible CO2 gas.
20260528_0007_opt3: It sublimates directly from solid to gas
20260528_0008_key: Why does your voice sound higher after breathing a little helium?
20260528_0008_answer: Sound travels faster in helium than in air, changing the resonant frequencies of your vocal tract. Your vocal cords do not actually shrink.
20260528_0008_opt1: Your vocal cords instantly get shorter
20260528_0008_opt2: Changed sound speed alters vocal resonance
20260528_0009_key: Which interaction helps water molecules form a roughly hexagonal structure in ice?
20260528_0009_answer: Hydrogen bonding creates the open crystal structure of ice. That structure makes ice less dense than liquid water, so it floats.
20260528_0010_key: What is the most direct reason cooking oil floats on water?
20260528_0010_answer: Cooking oil is less dense than water and does not mix well with it. That is why it forms a layer on top.
20260528_0010_opt3: Oil is less dense than water
20260528_0011_key: The Code of Hammurabi was mainly written in which writing system?
20260528_0011_answer: It was written in cuneiform, the wedge-shaped writing system used in ancient Mesopotamia. The famous law code was carved into a stone stele.
20260528_0012_key: The 1618 Defenestration of Prague is often described as a trigger for which major war?
20260528_0012_answer: It helped ignite religious and political conflict inside the Holy Roman Empire and is often treated as a starting point of the Thirty Years War.
20260528_0013_key: Which French scholar made the decisive breakthrough in deciphering Egyptian hieroglyphs?
20260528_0013_answer: Jean-François Champollion compared the scripts on the Rosetta Stone and made the key breakthrough in reading Egyptian hieroglyphs.
20260528_0014_key: Which figure is most closely linked to the 15th-century movable metal type printing revolution in Europe?
20260528_0014_answer: Johannes Gutenberg improved movable metal type and the printing press, dramatically lowering the cost of book production and speeding the spread of knowledge.
20260528_0015_key: What tool was commonly used to press writing into clay tablets in ancient Mesopotamia?
20260528_0015_answer: Scribes used a reed stylus to press wedge-shaped marks into wet clay tablets, creating cuneiform writing.
20260528_0016_key: Which country is completely surrounded by South Africa?
20260528_0016_answer: Lesotho is an enclaved country entirely surrounded by South Africa. It is one of the clearest examples of this unusual geography.
20260528_0017_key: Which narrow strait connects the Mediterranean Sea with the Atlantic Ocean?
20260528_0017_answer: The Strait of Gibraltar lies between the Iberian Peninsula and northwestern Africa, forming the gateway between the Mediterranean and the Atlantic.
20260528_0018_key: What do we commonly call the zone of frequent earthquakes and volcanoes around the edge of the Pacific?
20260528_0018_answer: The Ring of Fire follows major plate boundaries around the Pacific, which is why earthquakes and volcanoes are so common there.
20260528_0019_key: Singapore developed its "NEWater" program mainly to address what challenge?
20260528_0019_answer: Singapore has limited natural freshwater resources, so NEWater treats used water to a very high standard for reuse and strengthens water security.
20260528_0020_key: Which city spans both Europe and Asia across the Bosporus Strait?
20260528_0020_answer: Istanbul has urban districts on both the European and Asian sides of the Bosporus, making its location especially distinctive.
20260528_0021_key: The principle of habeas corpus is mainly meant to prevent what?
20260528_0021_answer: Habeas corpus requires the government to justify detention before a court, helping prevent unlawful imprisonment.
20260528_0022_key: When a work enters the public domain, what does that usually mean?
20260528_0022_answer: It means copyright protection has expired or does not apply, so the work can generally be used freely by the public.
20260528_0022_opt4: The authors name must be hidden
20260528_0023_key: In U.S. criminal procedure, what core rights does a Miranda warning communicate?
20260528_0023_answer: A Miranda warning tells suspects about the right to remain silent and the right to an attorney before custodial interrogation.
20260528_0023_opt2: The right to remain silent and have an attorney
20260528_0023_opt3: The right not to pay taxes
20260528_0023_opt4: The duty to serve on a jury
20260528_0024_key: Which principle best matches the GDPR approach to handling personal data?
20260528_0024_answer: The GDPR strongly emphasizes collecting and processing only the personal data needed for a specific purpose, with transparency and safeguards.
20260528_0024_opt1: Keep data as long as possible
20260528_0024_opt4: Process only what is needed for the purpose
20260528_0025_key: In a criminal trial, the idea that the prosecutor must prove guilt is most closely tied to which principle?
20260528_0025_answer: The presumption of innocence means the accused does not have to prove innocence; the state must prove guilt.
20260528_0026_key: In economics, what do we call the best alternative you give up when making a choice?
20260528_0026_answer: Opportunity cost is the value of the best option you did not choose. It can include time and experiences, not just money.
20260528_0027_key: Diversification mainly reduces which kind of investment risk?
20260528_0027_answer: Spreading money across assets reduces risks tied to one company or sector. It cannot remove broad market risk completely.
20260528_0028_key: What concept is roughly nominal interest minus the inflation rate?
20260528_0028_answer: The real interest rate is often approximated as nominal interest minus inflation, helping show changes in purchasing power.
20260528_0029_key: Why is a central bank called the "lender of last resort" during a financial crisis?
20260528_0029_answer: A central bank can provide emergency liquidity to solvent institutions under stress, helping prevent a broader financial collapse.
20260528_0029_opt2: Because it directly invests personal deposits
20260528_0029_opt3: Because it can supply emergency liquidity
20260528_0030_key: What usually happens to existing bond prices when market interest rates rise?
20260528_0030_answer: When market rates rise, older bonds with lower coupons become less attractive, so their prices usually fall. Bond prices and rates tend to move in opposite directions.
20260528_0030_opt4: They become equal to stock prices
20260528_0031_key: If an adult is severely choking and cannot speak or cough, what is the basic first-aid response?
20260528_0031_answer: For severe airway obstruction in a conscious adult, abdominal thrusts are commonly used, while calling for emergency help.
20260528_0032_key: What should you do first if a chemical splashes into the eye?
20260528_0032_answer: Flush the eye immediately with running water or saline for a sustained period. Rubbing or adding another chemical can make the injury worse.
20260528_0033_key: When you feel strong shaking indoors during an earthquake, what is the basic recommended action?
20260528_0033_answer: Drop, cover, and hold on helps protect you from falling objects until the shaking stops. Running outside during shaking can be more dangerous.
20260528_0034_key: Why is a carbon monoxide detector important?
20260528_0034_answer: Carbon monoxide is colorless and odorless, so people may not notice dangerous levels without a detector.
20260528_0034_opt2: Because it is colorless and odorless
20260528_0034_opt3: Because it always sinks to the floor
20260528_0035_key: An AED is designed especially for which emergency situation?
20260528_0035_answer: An AED analyzes heart rhythm during cardiac arrest and can deliver a shock when defibrillation is needed.
20260528_0036_key: Why can adding salt to ice water chill drinks faster?
20260528_0036_answer: Salt lowers the freezing point of the ice-water mixture, allowing it to become colder and pull heat from the drink more quickly.
20260528_0036_opt1: It lowers the freezing point of the mixture
20260528_0036_opt3: The ice becomes hard and never melts
20260528_0037_key: Why can baking soda help reduce odors in a refrigerator?
20260528_0037_answer: Baking soda is mildly basic and can help neutralize or adsorb some odor-causing compounds, especially acidic ones.
20260528_0037_opt4: It neutralizes and adsorbs some odor compounds
20260528_0038_key: Why does vinegar help remove white mineral scale on a faucet?
20260528_0038_answer: White scale often contains minerals such as calcium carbonate. The acid in vinegar helps dissolve those deposits.
20260528_0039_key: What is one advantage of freezing leftover herbs in oil cubes?
20260528_0039_answer: Freezing herbs in oil helps preserve some aroma and makes them easy to drop into soups or sauteed dishes later.
20260528_0039_opt3: They keep aroma and are easy to cook with
20260528_0040_key: Why does a microfiber cloth pick up dust so well?
20260528_0040_answer: Microfiber is made of extremely fine split fibers with a large surface area, so it can grip dust and dirt effectively.
20260528_0040_opt2: Very fine fibers grip dust well
20260528_0041_key: What does the HTTPS lock icon in a web address definitely mean?
20260528_0041_answer: HTTPS means the connection between your browser and the site is encrypted. It does not by itself prove the site is trustworthy.
20260528_0042_key: When avoiding phishing sites, what clue should you check first?
20260528_0042_answer: The address often gives the first warning. Check spelling, the domain, and suspicious subdomains before entering information.
20260528_0042_opt1: The spelling of the domain in the address bar
20260528_0042_opt2: Whether the background color is pretty
20260528_0043_key: What sensitive information can be stored in a smartphone photos metadata?
20260528_0043_answer: Photo metadata can include the time, device details, and location where the picture was taken, so it is worth checking before sharing.
20260528_0043_opt1: The blood type of people in the photo
20260528_0043_opt2: The future price of the lens
20260528_0043_opt3: The manufacturing cost of the battery
20260528_0043_opt4: The location where it was taken
20260528_0044_key: Why can a browser cache help webpages load faster?
20260528_0044_answer: A cache stores some files, such as images or scripts, on your device and reuses them on later visits, reducing downloads.
20260528_0044_opt1: It installs a new internet line
20260528_0044_opt2: It stores and reuses some data locally
20260528_0044_opt4: It moves the server into your computer
20260528_0045_key: In the 3-2-1 backup rule, what does the 1 usually mean?
20260528_0045_answer: The rule usually means three copies, two different types of storage media, and one copy kept off-site.
20260528_0045_opt4: Turn the computer on once a day
20260528_0046_key: What is the famous scream sound effect reused in many films called?
20260528_0046_answer: The Wilhelm scream is a stock sound effect reused in countless films and games, often as a playful inside joke.
20260528_0047_key: In films or games, what do we call a hidden joke, reference, or secret feature?
20260528_0047_answer: An Easter egg is a hidden detail placed by creators, often as a joke or reference for fans to discover.
20260528_0048_key: The classic Konami Code begins with which inputs?
20260528_0048_answer: The Konami Code famously starts with Up, Up, Down, Down, followed by Left, Right, Left, Right, B, A.
20260528_0049_key: In Japanese, what does the word "anime" broadly refer to?
20260528_0049_answer: In Japanese, anime comes from animation and broadly refers to animated works in general, regardless of country of origin.
20260528_0050_key: What do we often call a short extra scene shown during or after the end credits of a film?
20260528_0050_answer: A post-credits scene gives viewers a bonus joke, clue, or teaser after the main story has ended.
20260528_0051_key: Which vitamin can our skin help produce using sunlight?
20260528_0051_answer: UVB light can start vitamin D production in the skin. Balance matters, because too much sun exposure can damage skin.
20260528_0052_key: Why can dietary fiber support gut health?
20260528_0052_answer: Fiber can feed beneficial gut microbes and add bulk to stool, helping bowel movements. It may also slow rises in blood sugar.
20260528_0052_opt1: It supports gut microbes and bowel movements
20260528_0052_opt2: It turns all calories into zero
20260528_0052_opt3: It hydrates the body without water
20260528_0053_key: Why do oral rehydration solutions contain both sugar and salt?
20260528_0053_answer: Glucose and sodium are absorbed together in the intestine, helping pull water with them. ORS uses this to replace fluids and electrolytes.
20260528_0053_opt4: To help sodium and water absorption
20260528_0054_key: Why are people advised to reduce trans fat intake?
20260528_0054_answer: Trans fats can raise LDL cholesterol and lower HDL cholesterol, a combination linked to higher cardiovascular risk.
20260528_0054_opt2: They can raise LDL and lower HDL
20260528_0054_opt3: They make you drink only water
20260528_0054_opt4: They turn all fat into muscle
20260528_0055_key: Why can BMI alone fail to fully judge a person's health status?
20260528_0055_answer: BMI uses only height and weight, so it cannot distinguish muscle from fat or show fat distribution, age, or other health factors.
20260528_0055_opt3: It cannot distinguish muscle from fat
20260528_0056_key: What is the effect called when naming a words ink color becomes harder because the word names a different color?
20260528_0056_answer: The Stroop effect appears when automatic reading interferes with the task of naming the ink color, revealing attention and inhibition at work.
20260528_0057_key: What study strategy repeats material over increasing time intervals to improve memory?
20260528_0057_answer: Spaced repetition strengthens long-term memory by making you recall information just as you are beginning to forget it.
20260528_0058_key: What effect describes people becoming less likely to help when many others are present?
20260528_0058_answer: The bystander effect happens partly because responsibility feels diffused across the group, making each person less likely to act.
20260528_0059_key: What do we call the tendency to seek and trust information that supports our existing beliefs?
20260528_0059_answer: Confirmation bias makes us accept supporting evidence more readily while discounting contrary evidence, narrowing judgment.
20260528_0060_key: What is the tendency to remember unfinished tasks better than completed ones called?
20260528_0060_answer: The Zeigarnik effect describes how unfinished tasks can leave mental tension, making them easier to recall. Cliffhangers use a similar pull.
20260528_0061_key: What term describes how strongly a snowy surface reflects sunlight?
20260528_0061_answer: Albedo measures how much sunlight a surface reflects. Snow and ice have high albedo and send much light back.
20260528_0062_key: Why is methane important for climate even though there is less of it than carbon dioxide?
20260528_0062_answer: Methane has a shorter atmospheric lifetime than CO2 but a stronger warming effect per molecule, making reductions important for near-term warming.
20260528_0062_opt1: It has a strong warming effect per molecule
20260528_0062_opt4: It is made only of oxygen
20260528_0063_key: What problem often occurs when too much nitrogen and phosphorus enter a lake?
20260528_0063_answer: Excess nutrients can trigger algal blooms, and decomposition later consumes oxygen, harming fish and other aquatic life.
20260528_0063_opt4: Algal blooms and oxygen depletion occur
20260528_0064_key: Why are mangrove forests important for climate and coastal protection?
20260528_0064_answer: Mangroves reduce wave energy and store large amounts of carbon in roots and sediments, a form often discussed as blue carbon.
20260528_0064_opt2: They reduce waves and store carbon
20260528_0064_opt4: They turn all seawater into freshwater
20260528_0065_key: What is the process where pollutants like mercury can become more concentrated higher up a food chain?
20260528_0065_answer: Biomagnification occurs when persistent pollutants accumulate through the food chain, reaching higher concentrations in top predators.
20260528_0066_key: What does a website mainly try to distinguish by using a CAPTCHA?
20260528_0066_answer: A CAPTCHA is meant to tell human users apart from automated bots, though accessibility needs must also be considered.
20260528_0067_key: What information in satellite signals is especially important for GPS position calculation?
20260528_0067_answer: A GPS receiver compares very precise time signals from several satellites to estimate distances and calculate location.
20260528_0067_opt2: The photo resolution of the satellite
20260528_0067_opt3: A music signal from the satellite
20260528_0068_key: In machine learning, what does overfitting mean?
20260528_0068_answer: Overfitting happens when a model learns details and noise in the training data so closely that it performs poorly on new data.
20260528_0068_opt1: Fitting training data too closely and failing on new data
20260528_0068_opt2: A computer using too little electricity
20260528_0069_key: How is each block linked to the previous one in a blockchain?
20260528_0069_answer: Each block includes the hash of the previous block, so changing earlier data breaks the chain of hashes and becomes detectable.
20260528_0069_opt1: It repeats the same file name
20260528_0069_opt2: It mails a signed paper copy
20260528_0069_opt3: It includes the previous block's hash
20260528_0070_key: Why are dendrites considered dangerous in lithium-ion batteries?
20260528_0070_answer: Dendrites are needle-like lithium structures that can pierce separators and cause internal short circuits, creating safety risks.
20260528_0070_opt2: They can cause internal short circuits
20260528_0071_key: Which reaction helps browned meat and bread crust develop rich flavor?
20260528_0071_answer: The Maillard reaction occurs when sugars and amino acids react under heat, creating complex aromas and brown color.
20260528_0072_key: Why let a cooked steak rest briefly before cutting it?
20260528_0072_answer: Resting lets heat and juices redistribute somewhat, helping reduce juice loss when the steak is sliced.
20260528_0073_key: When pasta is cooked al dente, what texture does it have?
20260528_0073_answer: Al dente means firm to the bite, with a little resistance left in the center rather than being mushy.
20260528_0074_key: What principle lets mayonnaise keep oil and watery ingredients mixed?
20260528_0074_answer: Mayonnaise is an emulsion. Emulsifiers such as lecithin in egg yolk help stabilize tiny oil droplets so they do not separate quickly.
20260528_0075_key: What gas does yeast mainly produce to make bread dough rise?
20260528_0075_answer: Yeast breaks down sugars and produces carbon dioxide and alcohol. Carbon dioxide bubbles expand the dough.
20260528_0076_key: Why do curling players sweep hard in front of the stone?
20260528_0076_answer: Sweeping slightly warms and polishes the ice, reducing friction and helping control the stone's speed and path.
20260528_0076_opt1: To reduce friction and control the stone
20260528_0076_opt2: To block the other team's view
20260528_0076_opt4: To melt the ice into a stream
20260528_0077_key: For soccer offside decisions, which moment is usually most important?
20260528_0077_answer: Offside position is judged at the moment a teammate plays or passes the ball, not when the attacker later receives it.
20260528_0077_opt1: When the ball hits the goalpost
20260528_0077_opt2: When a teammate passes or plays the ball
20260528_0078_key: What is the usual order of events in a triathlon?
20260528_0078_answer: A standard triathlon is held in the order swim, bike, run. The order became standard for safety and event management reasons.
20260528_0079_key: How many feathers are usually used in a traditional badminton shuttlecock?
20260528_0079_answer: A traditional feather shuttlecock usually has 16 feathers. Their arrangement is crucial for stable flight.
20260528_0080_key: In the fencing weapon epee, what part of the body is valid target area?
20260528_0080_answer: In epee, the entire body is valid target area, from head to toe. That differs from foil and sabre.
20260528_0081_key: Which planet is famous for having a day longer than its year?
20260528_0081_answer: Venus rotates extremely slowly, taking about 243 Earth days to spin once, longer than its orbital period around the Sun.
20260528_0082_key: Why is Jupiter's moon Europa considered an important target in the search for life?
20260528_0082_answer: Europa likely has a liquid ocean beneath its icy crust, making it one of the most interesting places to study habitability.
20260528_0082_opt1: Forests have been confirmed on its surface
20260528_0082_opt2: Its atmosphere is full of oxygen
20260528_0082_opt3: It is closest to the Sun
20260528_0082_opt4: It may have an ocean beneath the ice
20260528_0083_key: What stage can a Sun-like star enter after using much of the hydrogen in its core?
20260528_0083_answer: After core hydrogen is depleted, a star can expand its outer layers and become a red giant, cooler at the surface but much larger.
20260528_0083_opt2: A black hole before white dwarf stage
20260528_0084_key: The James Webb Space Telescope is especially designed to observe which kind of light?
20260528_0084_answer: JWST is optimized for infrared observations, helping it study distant galaxies and star-forming regions through dust.
20260528_0085_key: Which celestial body has the largest effect on Earth's ocean tides?
20260528_0085_answer: Tides are caused mainly by the Moon's gravity, with the Sun also contributing. The Moon is close enough to create the stronger tidal effect.
20260528_0086_key: What dormancy strategy helps tardigrades survive extreme conditions by drying down?
20260528_0086_answer: In cryptobiosis, tardigrades slow their metabolism dramatically, helping them endure drying, cold, and radiation stress.
20260528_0087_key: What sound-based ability do dolphins use to find prey and obstacles underwater?
20260528_0087_answer: Dolphins use echolocation, producing sounds and interpreting returning echoes to understand their surroundings.
20260528_0088_key: What helps termites digest cellulose from wood?
20260528_0088_answer: Termites rely on symbiotic gut microbes that break down cellulose. It is a partnership between insect and microscopic helpers.
20260528_0089_key: Which ability makes the axolotl especially interesting to biologists?
20260528_0089_answer: Axolotls can regenerate limbs, tails, and even parts of some organs, making them important models for regenerative biology.
20260528_0090_key: What color is a polar bears skin beneath its white-looking fur?
20260528_0090_answer: Polar bear skin is close to black. The fur is almost translucent but scatters light, making the animal look white.
20260528_0091_key: What do we call colors that sit opposite each other on a color wheel?
20260528_0091_answer: Colors opposite each other on the color wheel are complementary colors. Placed together, they create strong contrast.
20260528_0092_key: In music, what kind of tempo does allegro usually indicate?
20260528_0092_answer: Allegro usually means a fast, lively tempo. It is one of the common tempo markings in classical scores.
20260528_0093_key: Fresco painting traditionally applies pigment to what kind of surface?
20260528_0093_answer: In buon fresco, pigment is applied to wet plaster, so the image bonds with the wall as the plaster dries.
20260528_0094_key: Which composer is most often associated with the twelve-tone technique in 20th-century music?
20260528_0094_answer: Arnold Schoenberg is closely associated with developing the twelve-tone method, which organizes all twelve chromatic pitches systematically.
20260528_0095_key: In perspective drawing, what is the point where parallel lines seem to meet in the distance called?
20260528_0095_answer: The vanishing point is where receding parallel lines appear to converge, helping create the illusion of depth.
20260528_0096_key: What do we call a word or phrase that reads the same forward and backward?
20260528_0096_answer: A palindrome reads the same in both directions, making it a favorite form of wordplay.
20260528_0097_key: Which statement about sign languages is most accurate?
20260528_0097_answer: Sign languages are natural languages with their own vocabulary and grammar, not just collections of gestures. Different regions can have different sign languages.
20260528_0097_opt2: They are only hand codes for spoken sounds
20260528_0097_opt3: They are natural languages with grammar
20260528_0098_key: In English, where is the Oxford comma usually placed?
20260528_0098_answer: The Oxford comma is placed before the final and or or in a list of three or more items, sometimes reducing ambiguity.
20260528_0098_opt1: At the very start of a sentence
20260528_0098_opt4: Before the final and or or
20260528_0099_key: What do we call a word borrowed from another language and used as part of ones own language?
20260528_0099_answer: A loanword enters through language contact. Words like coffee, bus, and radio are loanwords in many languages.
20260528_0100_key: The International Phonetic Alphabet, or IPA, was mainly created to record what?
20260528_0100_answer: The IPA was created to represent speech sounds from many languages with a consistent set of symbols.
